title: The King's Hit List, Part 10
description: The King's Hit List, Part 10 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Head into Shadow's Embrace and kill the Queen of Shadows and return to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold and 10 King's Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Head into Shadow's Embrace and kill the Queen of Shadows and return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

I know you've been dealing with undercover K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. agents, so I'll do you a favor and cut to the chase. We have had an agreement with the Guild of Shadows that has been mutually beneficial, but now things have shifted in our favor. The Guild of Shadows is dangerous, make no mistake, but we have been able to keep them in check by working with them. Now is our time to take the upper hand!

I want you to go into the Shadow's Embrace and take out the Queen of Shadows while she is weak with all the in fighting. Take her out and collect her Proof of Pwnage then return back to me, the mighty and powerful Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

The Queen of Shadows has been defeated? You are a true hero, Dungeon Runner. Now if you could just work on that ear hair issue....

Objectives:

  • Kill the Queen of Shadows
  • Collect Proof of Pwnage ×1

Level range: 45–100
